coverage_limits: I compared every printed word, punctuation mark, rubric, speaker siglum (חזן, ק׳) and the reading order on all eight pages against the dossier. Vowels were compared where legible. The images are only moderate resolution, so I could not certify meteg, ta'amim (most notably in Vayehi binsoa on s162), a few maqafs, or the holam-male spellings of קשט on s164; those are listed as unresolved. I did not reopen the human-settled items: the א״ז״וו abbreviation is on s156 and outside scope, and the s178–182 decisions do not overlap these pages. The s162 documentary instructions for placing the second scroll, lifting the first scroll, and the repeated response are not printed on s162. Running heads are not in the dossier and I did not treat them as omissions. On s159, the damaged 'inscribe' (line 4) and the broken aleph on s158 (petition 23) are print damage, not textual variants. Because readings are still unsettled, I make no acceptance claim.
